question: What is the meaning of customer return channels in relation to supply chain?
description: Customer return channels refer to the processes and systems through which customers return products back to the supply chain for various reasons, such as defects, dissatisfaction, or end-of-life product disposal. These channels play a crucial role in circular economy practices by enabling the recovery and recycling of materials, thus promoting sustainability and reducing waste. They also provide valuable feedback for manufacturers and service providers to improve product quality and design for circularity.

In the context of circular economy, consumers
typically include end-users, original equipment manufacturers, and
recycling companies within the supply chain (Jensen et al., 2023). These
consumers are stakeholders who are interested in the secondary raw
materials at the end of a product’s life but are often sceptical about
purchasing them. To solve this issue, it is important to gain their trust
and increase their confidence in and acceptance of secondary raw ma-
